attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) – Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Licensing Board

rules.alternatives: Instead of the 20 hours, the licensee may show an active certification in good standing from a nationally recognized professional organization that requires continuing education equal to or above 20 hours per two-year cycle (Utah Code 58-41-303(2)(b)).
rules.notes: At renewal the licensee shows 20 hours of division-approved CE completed in the preceding two-year renewal cycle, consistent with standards for maintaining competency in audiology or speech-language pathology, or an active national certification (as above). Two-year renewal cycle set by DOPL rule (R156-41); the exact expiration date is printed on the license. The statute was renumbered and amended by Ch. 140, 2026 General Session (effective May 6, 2026). DOPL's own pages and the current R156-41 text could not be opened from our location (403 / JavaScript-only site), so provider details are not included. Assistants work under supervision and are not separately licensed with CE.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Code §58-41-303; Utah Admin. Code R156-41
